bio: Nithya Varsha Raman (born July 28, 1981) is an American politician and urban planner who is the mayor-elect of Los Angeles. A member of the Democratic Party and the Democratic Socialists of America, Raman has served as the Los Angeles city councilmember for the 4th district since 2020.

items.q: She pledged to prioritize public health and environmental justice from that position.

items.t: Voted against LAMC section 41.18, the ordinance banning homeless encampments within 500 feet of schools and daycare centers (2021–2022).
items.q: Raman was one of three councilmembers to vote against LAMC section 41.18, a city ordinance that banned homeless encampments within 500 feet of schools and daycare centers.

items.t: Supports "a new approach to public safety" as part of her 2020 council platform.
